title: CAD, GD&T and PLM Workflows
metaDescription: Aaryan Lath's CAD and PLM work: Creo and Siemens NX assemblies with GD&T, SAP engineering change notices at Siemens, and Teamcenter PLM workflows.
hero: From parametric engine assemblies to production change notices, Aaryan works across the full design-data lifecycle: modeling in Creo and Siemens NX, dimensioning with GD&T, and managing releases through PLM systems like Teamcenter and Aras Innovator.

evidence.context: TurboFan Engine Assembly, a complete engine modeled as a personal project in Creo Parametric.
evidence.whatIDid: Built the full 3D parametric assembly with bypass ratio optimization studies, component integration and interference checking, and performance parameter calculations, applying GD&T across the design throughout.
evidence.outcome: The assembly ships with a browsable 3D model and a 21-image gallery on the project page.

evidence.context: Siemens Smart Infrastructure, Summer 2025 internship in the mechanical department at the Grand Prairie office.
evidence.whatIDid: Designed custom enclosures for panelboards in CREO and executed engineering change notices in SAP, and engineered neutral assemblies that resolved switchboard configuration edge cases in production designs.
evidence.outcome: Returned with a full-time offer; Aaryan joins Siemens Smart Infrastructure after graduation.

evidence.context: Single Piston Sterling Engine, a mechanical design project run through enterprise design-data tooling.
evidence.whatIDid: Designed the engine in Siemens NX and managed the design data through Teamcenter and Aras Innovator, exercising the same PLM release workflows used in industry alongside GD&T-driven detailing of the mechanism.
evidence.outcome: Project files and related CAD work are collected on the project page.

courses.note: Highlighted coursework touching part hierarchy and PLM fundamentals alongside the NX Sterling engine project.
